text:
maria (AE): Colossus Health asked for an acceptance matrix: sustained 120 qps with p99 < 350ms, burst to 800 qps for ~2m windows, KMS in-path, and audit logs. Can we run a reproducible test this week?

sam (SE): Yes. Proposed run: 30m soak at 120 qps, then 3x 2-minute microbursts to 800 qps spaced 5m apart. Compare two variants: f32 baseline and 4-bit quantized + KV prefix cache. We'll capture p50/p95/p99, GPU util, host queue depth, kernel fallbacks, and per-token infra cost.

raj (SRE): Reminder: KMS crypto can add tail latency when many concurrent decrypts occur. Need to check whether Colossus wants ALB TLS termination or passthrough to reduce extra copies.

maria (AE): They require KMS with customer-managed keys and VPC peering. Sales also needs a quick cost delta for reserved Dedicated vs Hosted burst.

zoe (ops): I can provision a temporary dedicated pool: 4xA100 + 1 standby. Batching target=16, max concurrency per GPU set conservatively. I'll open load-gen access and set up monitoring.

sam (SE): Load commands (repro):
```bash
# 30m soak at 120 qps
hey -z 30m -q 120 -c 250 -m POST -d '{"prompt":"<redacted>"}' https://staging-api.redwood/v1/generate
# 3 microbursts to 800 qps, 2m each
for i in 1 2 3; do hey -z 2m -q 800 -c 1000 -m POST -d '{"prompt":"x"}' https://staging-api.redwood/v1/generate; sleep 300; done
```
Will collect nvidia-smi samples, nginx/proxy worker stats, KMS call traces, and kernel-fallback logs.

ops-bot: deploy: dedicated-pool-colossus-1918 provisioning started. ETA 12m.

sam (SE): Post-run quick summary: Baseline f32 p99 (no KMS) ~ 280ms steady. Enabling KMS increased p99 to ~320-420ms with occasional spikes correlated to decrypt bursts. Quantized variant steady p99 ~470ms; during 800 qps microbursts quantized p99 spiked to ~620ms due to kernel fallback and queueing. GPU util: steady ~70% during soak, peaked ~94% during bursts. Host CPU queueing observed at peaks.

raj (SRE): Traces show KMS decrypts concurrent with inference requests causing blocking on proxy thread pool. Quick mitigation: pre-warm auth tokens and increase proxy worker threads; that cut ~8-12ms off tail in a follow-up run. Longer-term: consider async decrypt off the request path.

maria (AE): Can you produce numbers for pricing? Sales needs: monthly Dedicated reserved estimate for that pool and prorated test window cost; Hosted burst alternative cost per peak-qps-minute. Also show token-cost delta between f32 and quantized.

sam (SE): Draft pricing notes: Dedicated reserved (4xA100 + ops) ~"$9,500/month"; prorated multi-hour test ~"$1,100". Hosted burst estimate: "$0.10/peak-qps-minute" -> single 2m 800-qps burst ~ $160 (note: billing models vary). Token costs: baseline effective $0.018/token-equivalent; quantized saved ~18% -> $0.0147/token-equivalent, but infra overhead reduced net savings to ~12% overall. Treat as draft for negotiation.

zoe (ops): Security questionnaire blockers: HSM requirement, key custody details, and audit-log retention windows. They also want an automated canary rollout with fallback on SLA breach.

raj (SRE): I'll draft security answers: propose HSM-backed KMS (Private option), KMS key custody flow, and retention choices (30/90/365 days). Canary rollout recipe: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with health checks and automated fallback if p99 > 500ms for 10m.

maria (AE): Next steps: sam to produce a 1-page runbook + CSV/plots, zoe to share infra cost/prorate numbers, raj to draft security Q answers and canary recipe. I'll schedule a Friday 10am PT demo/hand-off with the customer.

sam (SE): Will upload runbook and results snapshot here. TL;DR: baseline f32 p99 = 280ms; quant steady p99 = 470ms; quant burst p99 = 620ms. Token cost delta ~18% savings, net effective ~12% after infra.

maria (AE): Thanks everyone 44d. I'll send the acceptance matrix + draft pricing to Colossus and follow up after Raj's security draft.

zoe (ops): I'll attach infra postmortem and prorated cost details in the follow-up thread.

raj (SRE): Security Q draft will be attached by EOD tomorrow.

maria (AE): Appreciated, team.
